primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And four of them were the sons of Mosiah; and their names were Ammon, and Aaron, and Omner, and Himni; these were the names of the sons of Mosiah.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Aaron suffers severe imprisonment and starvation in Middoni.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Nevertheless, Aaron and a certain number of his brethren were taken and cast into prison, and the remainder of them fled out of the land of Middoni unto the regions round about.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Aaron suffers severe imprisonment and starvation in Middoni.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And those who were cast into prison suffered many things, and they were delivered by the hand of Lamoni and Ammon, and they were fed and clothed.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Aaron converts the supreme Lamanite king, who falls to the earth in a spiritual trance.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that after Aaron had expounded these things unto him, the king said: What shall I do that I may have this eternal life of which thou hast spoken? Yea, what shall I do that I may be born of God, having this wicked spirit rooted out of my breast, and receive his Spirit, that I may be filled with joy, that I may not be cast off at the last day? Behold, said he, I will give up all that I possess, yea, I will forsake my kingdom, that I may receive this great joy.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Aaron converts the supreme Lamanite king, who falls to the earth in a spiritual trance.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: But Aaron said unto him: If thou desirest this thing, if thou wilt bow down before God, yea, if thou wilt repent of all thy sins, and will bow down before God, and call on his name in faith, believing that ye shall receive, then shalt thou receive the hope which thou desirest.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Aaron converts the supreme Lamanite king, who falls to the earth in a spiritual trance.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that when Aaron had said these words, the king did bow down before the Lord, upon his knees; yea, even he did prostrate himself upon the earth, and cried mightily, saying:

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Aaron converts the supreme Lamanite king, who falls to the earth in a spiritual trance.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: O God, Aaron hath told me that there is a God; and if there is a God, and if thou art God, wilt thou make thyself known unto me, and I will give away all my sins to know thee, and that I may be raised from the dead, and be saved at the last day. And now when the king had said these words, he was struck as if he were dead.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Abinadi is a unique name with no other characters bearing this name.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that there was a man among them whose name was Abinadi; and he went forth among them, and began to prophesy, saying: Behold, thus saith the Lord, and thus hath he commanded me, saying, Go forth, and say unto this people, thus saith the Lord—Wo be unto this people, for I have seen their abominations, and their wickedness, and their whoredoms; and except they repent I will visit them in mine anger.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Abinadi speaks with divine protection, his face shining as he delivers the law.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Touch me not, for God shall smite you if ye lay your hands upon me, for I have not delivered the message which the Lord sent me to deliver; neither have I told you that which ye requested that I should tell; therefore, God will not suffer that I shall be destroyed at this time.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Abinadi speaks with divine protection, his face shining as he delivers the law.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: But I must fulfil the commandments wherewith God has commanded me; and because I have told you the truth ye are angry with me. And again, because I have spoken the word of God ye have judged me that I am mad.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Abinadi dies by fire, becoming the first named martyr in the Nephite record.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And now, when Abinadi had said these words, he fell, having suffered death by fire; yea, having been put to death because he would not deny the commandments of God, having sealed the truth of his words by his death.

type_details.internal_notes: No confident forge Person crosswalk located. Gemini: Abish is a unique name with no other characters bearing this name in the Book of Mormon.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that they did call on the name of the Lord, in their might, even until they had all fallen to the earth, save it were one of the Lamanitish women, whose name was Abish, she having been converted unto the Lord for many years, on account of a remarkable vision of her father—

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Abish boldly raises the Lamanite queen, restoring order and faith to the chaotic household.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And thus the contention began to be exceedingly sharp among them. And while they were thus contending, the woman servant who had caused the multitude to be gathered together came, and when she saw the contention which was among the multitude she was exceedingly sorrowful, even unto tears.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Abish boldly raises the Lamanite queen, restoring order and faith to the chaotic household.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that she went and took the queen by the hand, that perhaps she might raise her from the ground; and as soon as she touched her hand she arose and stood upon her feet, and cried with a loud voice, saying: O blessed Jesus, who has saved me from an awful hell! O blessed God, have mercy on this people!

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Akish is a unique name, completely stable and requiring no disambiguation.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And now, therefore, let my father send for Akish, the son of Kimnor; and behold, I am fair, and I will dance before him, and I will please him, that he will desire me to wife; wherefore if he shall desire of thee that ye shall give unto him me to wife, then shall ye say: I will give her if ye will bring unto me the head of my father, the king.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Akish administers secret oaths to his house to murder King Omer.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that thus they did agree with Akish. And Akish did administer unto them the oaths which were given by them of old who also sought power, which had been handed down even from Cain, who was a murderer from the beginning.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Akish murders Jared, his father-in-law, and takes the crown.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that Akish sought the life of his father-in-law; and he applied unto those whom he had sworn by the oath of the ancients, and they obtained the head of his father-in-law, as he sat upon his throne, giving audience to his people.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Identity review is strictly required because of the generational same-name distinction between Alma the Elder (the father) and Alma the Younger (the son). primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: But there was one among them whose name was Alma, he also being a descendant of Nephi. And he was a young man, and he believed the words which Abinadi had spoken, for he knew concerning the iniquity which Abinadi has testified against them; therefore he began to plead with the king that he would not be angry with Abinadi, but suffer that he might depart in peace.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Alma baptizes the faithful, formally establishing the church.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And after this manner he did baptize every one that went forth to the place of Mormon; and they were in number about two hundred and four souls; yea, and they were baptized in the waters of Mormon, and were filled with the grace of God.

type_details.internal_notes: No confident forge Person crosswalk located. Gemini: Identity review is strictly required to cleanly sever his graph connections and event participation from his father, Alma the Elder. Classification disagreement: Gemini=IDENTITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED, Perplexity=PHASE1_MAJOR.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now the sons of Mosiah were numbered among the unbelievers; and also one of the sons of Alma was numbered among them, he being called Alma, after his father; nevertheless, he became a very wicked and an idolatrous man. And he was a man of many words, and did speak much flattery to the people; therefore he led many of the people to do after the manner of his iniquities.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Alma awakens from his coma, declaring he has been born of God.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass after they had fasted and prayed for the space of two days and two nights, the limbs of Alma received their strength, and he stood up and began to speak unto them, bidding them to be of good comfort:

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: For, said he, I have repented of my sins, and have been redeemed of the Lord; behold I am born of the Spirit.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now this man’s name was Nephihah, and he was appointed chief judge; and he sat in the judgment-seat to judge and to govern the people.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Amalickiah is a unique name, completely distinct and requiring no generational disambiguation.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that Amalickiah caused that one of his servants should administer poison by degrees to Lehonti, that he died.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that Teancum stole privily into the tent of the king, and put a javelin to his heart; and he did cause the death of the king immediately that he did not awake his servants.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Ammon chooses the path of servitude to win Lamoni's trust.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now the servants of the king began to murmur, saying: Now the king will slay us, as he has our brethren because their flocks were scattered by the wickedness of these men. And they began to weep exceedingly, saying: Behold, our flocks are scattered already.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Ammon chooses the path of servitude to win Lamoni's trust.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now they wept because of the fear of being slain. Now when Ammon saw this his heart was swollen within him with joy; for, said he, I will show forth my power unto these my fellow-servants, or the power which is in me, in restoring these flocks unto the king, that I may win the hearts of these my fellow-servants, that I may lead them to believe in my words.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Ammon demonstrates miraculous physical prowess in defending the king's flocks.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: But behold, every man that lifted his club to smite Ammon, he smote off their arms with his sword; for he did withstand their blows by smiting their arms with the edge of his sword, insomuch that they began to be astonished, and began to flee before him; yea, and they were not few in number; and he caused them to flee by the strength of his arm.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Ammon demonstrates miraculous physical prowess in defending the king's flocks.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now six of them had fallen by the sling, but he slew none save it were their leader with his sword; and he smote off as many of their arms as were lifted against him, and they were not a few.

type_details.internal_notes: Multiple forge Person records may correspond; no selection made. Same-name collision risk in current forge inventory.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that on the morrow they started to go up, having with them one Ammon, he being a strong and mighty man, and a descendant of Zarahemla; and he was also their leader.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Ammoron requires careful identity review because of same-name spelling confusion with Ammaron (the righteous record keeper in Mormon 1). Disambiguation from the record keeper is essential. Classification disagreement: Gemini=PHASE1_SUPPORTING, Perplexity=PHASE1_MAJOR.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that the brother of Amalickiah was appointed king over the people; and his name was Ammoron; thus king Ammoron, the brother of king Amalickiah, was appointed to reign in his stead.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Ammoron is slain by Teancum in his camp, ending the dynastic threat.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that Teancum in his anger did go forth into the camp of the Lamanites, and did let himself down over the walls of the city. And he went forth with a cord, from place to place, insomuch that he did find the king; and he did cast a javelin at him, which did pierce him near the heart. But behold, the king did awaken his servants before he died, insomuch that they did pursue Teancum, and slew him.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Amulek is a unique name in the Book of Mormon, highly stable and requiring no disambiguation.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that the man received him into his house; and the man was called Amulek; and he brought forth bread and meat and set before Alma.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Amulek establishes his former status and angelic visitation.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: For behold, he hath blessed mine house, he hath blessed me, and my women, and my children, and my father and my kinsfolk; yea, even all my kindred hath he blessed, and the blessing of the Lord hath rested upon us according to the words which he spake.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Amulek's critical, defining discourse on the infinite Atonement.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: For it is expedient that there should be a great and last sacrifice; yea, not a sacrifice of man, neither of beast, neither of any manner of fowl; for it shall not be a human sacrifice; but it must be an infinite and eternal sacrifice.

type_details.internal_notes: No confident forge Person crosswalk located. Census omission-control row 51: Amulon (Kings & Judges).

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now the name of the leader of those priests was Amulon.
Now the king conferred the kingdom upon his son, and he called his name Anti-Nephi-Lehi.

type_details.internal_notes: Mahonri Moriancumer census surface is external/non-scriptural; not used as canonical display name. Gemini: The Brother of Jared is only named 'the brother of Jared' in the scriptural text. We must strictly use this source-first name.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: The Brother of Jared sees the finger of the Lord touching the sixteen stones.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that when the brother of Jared had said these words, behold, the Lord stretched forth his hand and touched the stones one by one with his finger. And the veil was taken from off the eyes of the brother of Jared, and he saw the finger of the Lord; and it was as the finger of a man, like unto flesh and blood; and the brother of Jared fell down before the Lord, for he was struck with fear.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Christ reveals His spirit body to the Brother of Jared.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Behold, I am he who was prepared from the foundation of the world to redeem my people. Behold, I am Jesus Christ. I am the Father and the Son. In me shall all mankind have life, and that eternally, even they who shall believe on my name; and they shall become my sons and my daughters.

type_details.internal_notes: Multiple forge Person records may correspond; no selection made. Same-name collision risk in current forge inventory. Gemini: Identity review is strictly required because of the major name distinction between Captain Moroni (the commander of the Title of Liberty in Alma 46) and Moroni the son of Mormon (the final prophet). Classification disagreement: Gemini=IDENTITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED, Perplexity=PHASE1_MAJOR.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now, the leader of the Nephites, or the man who had been appointed to be the chief captain over the Nephites—now the chief captain took the command of all the armies of the Nephites—and his name was Moroni;

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Moroni creates the Title of Liberty, establishing the covenant of defense.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that he rent his coat; and he took a piece thereof, and wrote upon it—In memory of our God, our religion, and freedom, and our peace, our wives, and our children—and he fastened it upon the end of a pole.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Moroni creates the Title of Liberty, establishing the covenant of defense.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And he fastened on his head-plate, and his breastplate, and his shields, and girded on his armor about his loins; and he took the pole, which had on the end thereof his rent coat, (and he called it the title of liberty) and he bowed himself to the earth, and he prayed mightily unto his God for the blessings of liberty to rest upon his brethren, so long as there should a band of Christians remain to possess the land—

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Mormon's glowing, supreme tribute to Moroni's character.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And Moroni was a strong and a mighty man; he was a man of a perfect understanding; yea, a man that did not delight in bloodshed; a man whose soul did joy in the liberty and the freedom of his country, and his brethren from bondage and slavery;

type_details.internal_notes: Census omission-control row 68: Corianton (Wars & Late Judges).

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now the eldest of his sons he took not with him, and his name was Helaman; but the names of those whom he took with him were Shiblon and Corianton; and these are the names of those who went with him among the Zoramites, to preach unto them the word.

type_details.internal_notes: No confident forge Person crosswalk located. Gemini: Identity review is strictly required because of the same-name distinction: Coriantumr the early Jaredite king (Ether 9), Coriantumr the last Jaredite king (this figure), and Coriantumr the Nephite dissenter/commander (Helaman 1). No confident forge Person crosswalk located. Census row may correspond to an existing candidate; not merged.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that the days of Ether were in the days of Coriantumr; and Coriantumr was king over all the land.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Ether's prophecy that Coriantumr will survive to see another people inherit the land.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Otherwise they should be destroyed, and all his household save it were himself. And he should only live to see the fulfilling of the prophecies which had been spoken concerning another people receiving the land for their inheritance; and Coriantumr should receive a burial by them; and every soul should be destroyed save it were Coriantumr.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Coriantumr is discovered by the people of Zarahemla.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And they gave an account of one Coriantumr, and the slain of his people. And Coriantumr was discovered by the people of Zarahemla; and he dwelt with them for the space of nine moons.

type_details.internal_notes: No confident forge Person crosswalk located.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And they came down again that they might pitch battle against the Nephites. And they were led by a man whose name was Coriantumr; and he was a descendant of Zarahemla; and he was a dissenter from among the Nephites; and he was a large and a mighty man.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: The daughter of Jared is only named 'the daughter of Jared' in the scriptural text. She must be classified under this descriptive title.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now the daughter of Jared was exceedingly fair. And it came to pass that she did talk with her father, and said unto him: Whereby hath my father so much sorrow? Hath he not read the record which our fathers brought across the great deep? Behold, is there not an account concerning them of old, that they by their secret plans did obtain kingdoms and great glory?

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: The daughter of Jared conceives the plan of secret combinations based on ancient records.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now the daughter of Jared being exceedingly expert, and seeing the sorrows of her father, thought to devise a plan whereby she could redeem the kingdom unto her father.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: The daughter of Jared dances before Akish, initiating the deadly bargain.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And now Omer was a friend to Akish; wherefore, when Jared had sent for Akish, the daughter of Jared danced before him that she pleased him, insomuch that he desired her to wife. And it came to pass that he said unto Jared: Give her unto me to wife.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Enos is a highly stable name, with no other characters bearing this name in the text. Classification disagreement: Gemini=PHASE1_MAJOR, Perplexity=PHASE1_SUPPORTING.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Behold, it came to pass that I, Enos, knowing my father that he was a just man—for he taught me in his language, and also in the nurture and admonition of the Lord—and blessed be the name of my God for it—

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Enos engages in a day-long wrestle before God for his soul.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And my soul hungered; and I kneeled down before my Maker, and I cried unto him in mighty prayer and supplication for mine own soul; and all the day long did I cry unto him; yea, and when the night came I did still raise my voice high that it reached the heavens.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: The Lord covenants with Enos to preserve the records for the Lamanites' future redemption.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And now behold, this was the desire which I desired of him—that if it should so be, that my people, the Nephites, should fall into transgression, and by any means be destroyed, and the Lamanites should not be destroyed, that the Lord God would preserve a record of my people, the Nephites; even if it so be by the power of his holy arm, that it might be brought forth at some future day unto the Lamanites, that, perhaps, they might be brought unto salvation—

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Ether is a unique name of a person, though his name is also used as a book name. Disambiguation from the book is needed.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that Coriantor begat Ether, and he died, having dwelt in captivity all his days.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Ether's famous definition of faith as an anchor to the souls of men.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Wherefore, whoso believeth in God might with surety hope for a better world, yea, even a place at the right hand of God, which hope cometh of faith, maketh an anchor to the souls of men, which would make them sure and steadfast, always abounding in good works, being led to glorify God.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Ether finishes his record and hides it to be discovered by Limhi's explorers.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And the Lord spake unto Ether, and said unto him: Go forth. And he went forth, and beheld that the words of the Lord had all been fulfilled; and he finished his record; (and the hundredth part I have not written) and he hid them in a manner that the people of Limhi did find them.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Never explicitly named in the text; identified strictly as 'father of Lamoni' or 'king over all the land'. Must be reconstructed as a discrete, major identity despite lacking a proper personal name.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: The king is willing to surrender his entire empire to know God.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that after Aaron had expounded these things unto him, the king said: What shall I do that I may have this eternal life of which thou hast spoken? Yea, what shall I do that I may be born of God, having this wicked spirit rooted out of my breast, and receive his Spirit, that I may be filled with joy, that I may not be cast off at the last day? Behold, said he, I will give up all that I possess, yea, I will forsake my kingdom, that I may receive this great joy.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: The king is willing to surrender his entire empire to know God.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: But Aaron said unto him: If thou desirest this thing, if thou wilt bow down before God, yea, if thou wilt repent of all thy sins, and will bow down before God, and call on his name in faith, believing that ye shall receive, then shalt thou receive the hope which thou desirest.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: The king is willing to surrender his entire empire to know God.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that when Aaron had said these words, the king did bow down before the Lord, upon his knees; yea, even he did prostrate himself upon the earth, and cried mightily, saying:

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: The king is willing to surrender his entire empire to know God.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: O God, Aaron hath told me that there is a God; and if there is a God, and if thou art God, wilt thou make thyself known unto me, and I will give away all my sins to know thee, and that I may be raised from the dead, and be saved at the last day. And now when the king had said these words, he was struck as if he were dead.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: The king issues a proclamation of peace, protecting the missionaries.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Behold, now it came to pass that the king of the Lamanites sent a proclamation among all his people, that they should not lay their hands on Ammon, or Aaron, or Omner, or Himni, nor either of their brethren who should go forth preaching the word of God, in whatsoever place they should be, in any part of their land.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Gadianton is a unique name, completely stable and requiring no generational disambiguation. Classification disagreement: Gemini=PHASE1_MAJOR, Perplexity=PHASE1_SUPPORTING.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: For there was one Gadianton, who was exceedingly expert in many words, and also in his craft, to carry on the secret work of murder and of robbery; therefore he became the leader of the band of Kishkumen.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Mormon explicitly identifies Gadianton as the author of the ruinous secret combinations.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And now behold, those murderers and plunderers were a band who had been formed by Kishkumen and Gadianton. And now it had come to pass that there were many, even among the Nephites, of Gadianton’s band. But behold, they were more numerous among the more wicked part of the Lamanites. And they were called Gadianton’s robbers and murderers.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Giddianhi is a unique name, highly stable and requiring no disambiguation.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And behold, I am Giddianhi; and I am the governor of this the secret society of Gadianton; which society and the works thereof I know to be good; and they are of ancient date and they have been handed down unto us.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Giddianhi writes a threatening, sophisticated epistle to Lachoneus demanding total surrender.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And now it came to pass that in the sixteenth year from the coming of Christ, Lachoneus, the governor of the land, received an epistle from the leader and the governor of this band of robbers; and these were the words which were written, saying:

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Giddianhi is defeated and slain in battle while retreating.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that Giddianhi, who had stood and fought with boldness, was pursued as he fled; and being weary because of his much fighting he was overtaken and slain. And thus was the end of Giddianhi the robber.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Gideon is a unique name of a person, though his name is heavily used to designate the Valley of Gideon and the city of Gideon. Disambiguation from the places is strictly needed.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And now there was a man among them whose name was Gideon, and he being a strong man and an enemy to the king, therefore he drew his sword, and swore in his wrath that he would slay the king.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Gideon presents the ingenious escape plan to King Limhi.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now it came to pass that Gideon went forth and stood before the king, and said unto him: Now O king, thou hast hitherto hearkened unto my words many times when we have been contending with our brethren, the Lamanites.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Gideon presents the ingenious escape plan to King Limhi.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And now O king, if thou hast not found me to be an unprofitable servant, or if thou hast hitherto listened to my words in any degree, and they have been of service to thee, even so I desire that thou wouldst listen to my words at this time, and I will be thy servant and deliver this people out of bondage.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Gideon's advanced age and role as a teacher in the church before his murder.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now the name of the man was Gideon; and it was he who was an instrument in the hands of God in delivering the people of Limhi out of bondage.
Now the chiefest among all the chief captains and the great commander of the armies of the Nephites was appointed, and his name was Gidgiddoni.
