nodes.display_name: Sons of Lehi obtain the brass plates from Laban

type_details.boundary_notes: Mission bounded by command to obtain records through successful retrieval.
type_details.summary: Laman, Lemuel, Sam, and Nephi make successive journeys to Jerusalem for the brass plates.

aliases: Nephi returns with the brass plates and Zoram
nodes.display_name: Nephi returns with the brass plates and Zoram

type_details.boundary_notes: Return episode from Zoram's covenant through Sariah's testimony; distinct from the Jerusalem retrieval attempts.
type_details.summary: Nephi and his brothers return to the camp with the brass plates; Zoram joins the company.

aliases: Divine Chastening, Barge Preparation, and Mount Shelem Theophany
nodes.display_name: Divine Chastening, Barge Preparation, and Mount Shelem Theophany

type_details.boundary_notes: Reused ID; Ether 4–5 not included; Mount Shelem theophany only.
type_details.summary: After a three-hour chastening the brother of Jared repents. Ocean-going barges are prepared; air and light problems are resolved with sixteen stones. On Mount Shelem the Lord touches the stones, the brother of Jared sees the Lord, receives a sealed vision, and the interpreters are prepared.

aliases: Captain Moroni raises the Title of Liberty against Amalickiah's rebellion
nodes.display_name: Captain Moroni raises the Title of Liberty against Amalickiah's rebellion

type_details.boundary_notes: Reused ID; widened boundary; Amalickiahites not freemen.
type_details.summary: Amalickiah builds a movement seeking kingship. Moroni raises the Title of Liberty, rallies those willing to preserve freedom, and moves against the Amalickiahites. Amalickiah flees toward Nephi while his remaining followers are compelled to covenant for the cause of freedom.

aliases: Jesus Christ's first visitation at Bountiful
nodes.display_name: Jesus Christ's first visitation at Bountiful

type_details.boundary_notes: NR2-001: spans narrator bridge (3 Nephi 10:18–19) through first visitation and ascension (3 Nephi 18:39); temple/multitude gathering at 3 Nephi 11:1; no Church-of-Christ Group edge.
type_details.summary: In the ending of the thirty-fourth year, the spared people receive the promise that Christ will manifest himself to them. A great multitude gathers at the temple in the land Bountiful. The Father's voice identifies Jesus Christ. Christ descends, identifies himself, invites the multitude to witness his wounds one by one, calls Nephi forward, gives power and instructions concerning baptism, teaches the multitude, heals the sick, blesses the children, angels minister, bread and wine are administered, and Christ finally departs and ascends into heaven.

aliases: The sign of Christ's birth fulfills Samuel's prophecy
nodes.display_name: The sign of Christ's birth fulfills Samuel's prophecy

type_details.boundary_notes: Sign occurs in 92nd year; no believers/unbelievers Groups; no inferred Zarahemla Place.
type_details.summary: In the commencement of the ninety-second year unbelievers dispute Samuel's prophecy; Nephi son of Nephi prays, receives assurance, the night remains light without darkness at sunset, a new star appears, and many believe and are baptized.

aliases: Great destruction and darkness at Christ's death
nodes.display_name: Great destruction and darkness at Christ's death

type_details.boundary_notes: 34th year, 1st month, 4th day anchor at 3 Nephi 8:5; no per-city Events or Places.
type_details.summary: In the thirty-fourth year, storms, tempests, earthquakes, fire and other destruction devastate cities and alter the land. Darkness follows and the survivors mourn.

aliases: Jesus Christ appears again to the disciples
nodes.display_name: Jesus Christ appears again to the disciples

type_details.boundary_notes: Later recorded appearance; naming/dispute of already-existing church (3 Nephi 26:21); not Christ establishing the church here; exact date unknown.
type_details.summary: While the disciples are traveling and preaching, they gather in prayer and fasting over a dispute concerning the church's name. Jesus appears again, addresses the name of the church and his gospel, then asks the disciples one by one what they desire. Nine make one request and the remaining three desire to continue ministering. Christ touches the nine and departs.

aliases: Jesus Christ's second visitation and three-day ministry
nodes.display_name: Jesus Christ's second visitation and three-day ministry

type_details.boundary_notes: SECOND_VISITATION_BEGINS_ON_THE_MORROW / MINISTRY_SPANS_THREE_DAYS / LATER_APPEARANCES_ALSO_RECORDED; not a single calendar day.
type_details.summary: On the morrow the disciples and multitude gather. The disciples teach and are baptized, receive the Holy Ghost, and angels minister. Jesus returns, prays, administers bread and wine again, and teaches extensively concerning covenant and scripture. He commands the record concerning Samuel's fulfilled prophecy to be corrected and gives additional scriptural teachings. The record states that this ministry extended for three days before Christ's second recorded ascension.

aliases: The voice of Christ speaks in the darkness
nodes.display_name: The voice of Christ speaks in the darkness

type_details.boundary_notes: 3 Nephi 10:11–19 is outside this Event (narrator transition).
type_details.summary: During the darkness, a voice is heard throughout the land. Jesus Christ identifies himself, describes the destruction, declares fulfillment, calls the survivors to repentance, speaks again after silence, and the darkness eventually disperses as mourning turns to joy.

aliases: Wars of Shared, Gilead, and Lib
nodes.display_name: Wars of Shared, Gilead, and Lib

type_details.boundary_notes: KINSHIP LOCK: Gilead = brother of Shared; Shiz = brother of Lib (later Event); Lib kinship to Shared/Gilead NOT asserted.
type_details.summary: Shared rises against Coriantumr and is eventually slain. Coriantumr is captured and restored, then wounded and recovers. Gilead, explicitly brother of Shared, takes Moron and is murdered by the high priest. Lib kills the high priest and takes power, then is slain battling Coriantumr. Do NOT assert Lib brother/son of Shared or Gilead.

aliases: Coriantumr captures Zarahemla and is defeated
nodes.display_name: Coriantumr captures Zarahemla and is defeated

type_details.boundary_notes: Coriantumr person:000223 is the Nephite dissenter commander—not the Jaredite king.
type_details.summary: A Lamanite army led by Coriantumr—a dissenter Nephite descendant of Zarahemla—captures the city of Zarahemla, kills Pacumeni, and drives toward Bountiful until Moronihah traps the invaders; Coriantumr is slain and surviving Lamanites surrender.

type_details.boundary_notes: Corihor, Kib, Shule, Noah, Cohor contextual; no new People.
type_details.summary: Corihor rebels and Kib is taken captive in the land of Moron and land of Nehor. Shule is born in captivity, prepares weapons on hill Ephraim, and restores the kingdom. A Noah/Cohor rebellion cycle follows; prophets warn; Shule protects prophetic preaching and the people repent.

type_details.boundary_notes: Reused ID; Mormon survives wounded; Mormon does NOT die here; no Cumorah generals minted.
type_details.summary: The Lamanite armies attack the gathered Nephites. Mormon is wounded but survives. Moroni also survives. On the morrow twenty-four survivors view the dead, and Mormon laments the destruction of his people.

aliases: Lehi's family departs Jerusalem into the wilderness
nodes.display_name: Lehi's family departs Jerusalem into the wilderness

type_details.boundary_notes: Continuous departure episode; does not include later return missions.
type_details.summary: Lehi obeys the Lord's command to leave Jerusalem with his family and provisions.

aliases: Disciples minister and the Church of Christ community grows
nodes.display_name: Disciples minister and the Church of Christ community grows

type_details.boundary_notes: group:000045 for post-Christ church of Christ community; not back-propagated to earlier eras.
type_details.summary: After Christ's second ascension, on the morrow the disciples teach and baptize. Extraordinary manifestations continue, the believers share their possessions, and those baptized in the name of Jesus are explicitly called the church of Christ.

type_details.boundary_notes: Coriantum prosperity king ≠ Coriantor father of Ether.
type_details.summary: After Omer, Emer reigns righteously and prospers; Emer sees the Son of Righteousness. Coriantum continues prosperity with cities and economic development until succession to Com. Emer, Coriantum, and Com remain contextual.

type_details.boundary_notes: Ether 12:6–41 excluded as Moroni editorial; Coriantumr reign context only.
type_details.summary: Ether prophesies in the days of Coriantumr, calling the people to faith and repentance. The people do not believe. Historical narrative stops at Ether 12:5; Ether 12:6 onward is Moroni's editorial discourse.

aliases: Ether Is Rejected and Warns Coriantumr
nodes.display_name: Ether Is Rejected and Warns Coriantumr

type_details.boundary_notes: Omni Coriantumr account not included; Coriantumr survives this Event.
type_details.summary: Ether prophesies concerning the New Jerusalem; the people reject him and he hides in the cavity of a rock, observing wars and writing the record. The Lord commands Ether to warn Coriantumr of conditional destruction and that Coriantumr would live to see another people possess the land. Coriantumr rejects the warning and attempts to kill Ether, who returns to hiding.

aliases: Nephi's famine leads the people to repentance
nodes.display_name: Nephi's famine leads the people to repentance

type_details.boundary_notes: Helaman 11:10 documents extinction of the existing Gadianton band.
type_details.summary: Civil and robber conflict leads Nephi to ask God for famine rather than war. The famine intensifies until the people repent; Nephi prays for relief, rain returns, and peace and church growth follow. The band of Gadianton becomes extinct.

aliases: Gadianton robbers infiltrate the Nephite government
nodes.display_name: Gadianton robbers infiltrate the Nephite government

type_details.boundary_notes: Cezoram's unnamed son is not Seezoram; no Cezoram–Seezoram kinship.
type_details.summary: Cezoram is murdered and his unnamed son succeeds him and is also murdered. The secret combination traced to Kishkumen and Gadianton spreads among Nephites while Lamanites seek to destroy robbers among themselves; robbers obtain control of Nephite government.

aliases: Gadianton combinations revive as society collapses
nodes.display_name: Gadianton combinations revive as society collapses

type_details.boundary_notes: Organizational/traditional revival YES; uninterrupted membership continuity NO; unified era had no robbers at 4 Nephi 1:17.
type_details.summary: The wicked majority grows. After the 250th/260th-year sequence, the wicked begin again to build the secret oaths and combinations of Gadianton. Nephites also grow proud; by 300 years both Nephites and Lamanites are exceedingly wicked, and Gadianton robbers spread across the land.

aliases: A new robber band adopts Gadianton's secret plans
nodes.display_name: A new robber band adopts Gadianton's secret plans

type_details.boundary_notes: Faction tradition continuity yes; identical membership continuity no.
type_details.summary: Dissenters renew warfare, retreat into wilderness and mountains, search out Gadianton's secret plans, and become robbers of Gadianton; military expeditions fail and robber power increases. Gadianton the person is not present.

aliases: Gadianton siege, defeat, and postwar settlement
nodes.display_name: Gadianton siege, defeat, and postwar settlement

type_details.boundary_notes: One Event; no separate micro-events for deaths or battle phases.
type_details.summary: The Gadianton forces attack the gathered people. Gidgiddoni leads the defense. Giddianhi is slain, Zemnarihah succeeds him, and the robber forces are ultimately defeated. Zemnarihah is hanged, captives are dealt with, and the surviving repentant robbers are incorporated peacefully.

aliases: Gadianton robbers resurge and war spreads
nodes.display_name: Gadianton robbers resurge and war spreads

type_details.boundary_notes: Converted Lamanites numbered among Nephites in 3 Nephi 2; no temporary army Group.
type_details.summary: Gadianton robbers again infest the land and increase as dissenters join them. Conflict intensifies. Converted Lamanites unite with the Nephites against the robbers and are explicitly numbered among the Nephites.

aliases: Nephites gather at Cumorah and Mormon deposits the records
nodes.display_name: Nephites gather at Cumorah and Mormon deposits the records

type_details.boundary_notes: Preparation ends 6:6; battle begins 6:7; no modern New York geography.
type_details.summary: Mormon asks the Lamanite king for permission to gather the people to Cumorah. By year 384 the remainder of the people have gathered. Mormon hides the sacred records entrusted to him in hill Cumorah, except for a few plates given to his son Moroni.

type_details.boundary_notes: Defensive gathering from Zarahemla to Bountiful; Gadianton tradition continuity yes, identical membership continuity no (3 Nephi 3:9).
type_details.summary: Giddianhi demands surrender from Lachoneus. Lachoneus rejects the ultimatum, calls the people to repentance and defensive gathering, appoints Gidgiddoni as chief captain, and the people consolidate and fortify themselves.

aliases: Gideon confronts Noah; Limhi becomes king
nodes.display_name: Gideon confronts Noah; Limhi becomes king

type_details.boundary_notes: Gideon–Noah conflict through Limhi's installation and tribute oath.
type_details.summary: Gideon fights Noah; Noah flees, is killed by his men, and Limhi is made king.

aliases: Hearthom's Captive Line, Com, and Renewed Robbers
nodes.display_name: Hearthom's Captive Line, Com, and Renewed Robbers

type_details.boundary_notes: GENEALOGY LOCK: Hearthom→Heth→Aaron→Amnigaddah→Coriantum→Com; Coriantum captive king ≠ Coriantor; robber revival = tradition not Akish membership.
type_details.summary: Hearthom loses the kingdom and lives in captivity. Captive sequence: Hearthom, Heth, Aaron, Amnigaddah, Coriantum, then Com. Do NOT encode Hearthom→Aaron directly. Com draws away half the kingdom, defeats Amgid, fights robbers who adopt old plans/oaths, and protects prophets who flee to him.

aliases: Helaman's army gains Antiparah and Cumeni
nodes.display_name: Helaman's army gains Antiparah and Cumeni

type_details.boundary_notes: Continuing 2,060 warrior unit; not a second Group.
type_details.summary: Antiparah falls into Helaman's hands, sixty more sons of the Ammonites join the force, Cumeni is surrounded and surrendered, and Helaman's 2,060 young warriors hold firm during the subsequent battle. Every one of the 2,060 is wounded, but none is killed.

aliases: Helaman's young warriors help Antipus defeat the Lamanites
nodes.display_name: Helaman's young warriors help Antipus defeat the Lamanites

type_details.boundary_notes: Does not begin at Alma 56:1 reporting frame; Antipus contextual.
type_details.summary: Helaman brings his two thousand young warriors to Judea to reinforce Antipus. A stratagem draws the Lamanite army from Antiparah; Antipus is killed during the battle, Helaman's soldiers turn back to aid the Nephites, and all two thousand survive.

aliases: Northward expansion, church growth, and Nephi succeeds Helaman
nodes.display_name: Northward expansion, church growth, and Nephi succeeds Helaman

type_details.boundary_notes: No land-northward Place minted; no separate sub-development Events.
type_details.summary: Many migrate from Zarahemla toward the land northward; cement construction expands where timber is scarce; the people of Ammon participate; Gadianton combinations remain hidden; church growth and baptisms increase; Helaman dies and Nephi receives the judgment-seat.

aliases: Helaman's forces recover Manti by stratagem
nodes.display_name: Helaman's forces recover Manti by stratagem

type_details.boundary_notes: Gid and Teomner contextual; no wilderness Place minting.
type_details.summary: Helaman's weakened force waits for support, then uses a decoy and flanking maneuver to draw the Lamanites away from Manti and recover the city. His account closes by emphasizing the preservation and faith of the sons of the people of Ammon.

aliases: Heth's Usurpation, Famine, and Poisonous Serpents
nodes.display_name: Heth's Usurpation, Famine, and Poisonous Serpents

type_details.boundary_notes: Secret-plan revival = tradition; not identical Akish membership.
type_details.summary: Heth embraces old secret plans and kills Com. Prophets warn and are persecuted. Drought and famine follow; poisonous serpents drive the people; the population is humbled and recovery begins. Land southward remains contextual, not modern geography.

aliases: Ishmael dies and is buried at Nahom
nodes.display_name: Ishmael dies and is buried at Nahom

type_details.boundary_notes: Death and burial at Nahom only; distinct from the broken-bow food crisis ending at 16:32.
type_details.summary: Ishmael dies in the wilderness and is buried in the place called Nahom.

aliases: Ishmael's family joins Lehi in the wilderness
nodes.display_name: Ishmael's family joins Lehi in the wilderness

type_details.boundary_notes: Journey to and return with Ishmael's household.
type_details.summary: Lehi's sons return to Jerusalem and bring Ishmael's family into the wilderness company.

aliases: Great Tower Departure and Wilderness Migration
nodes.display_name: Great Tower Departure and Wilderness Migration

type_details.boundary_notes: Reused ID; inland barge crossings not split; Ether 4–5 excluded as editorial.
type_details.summary: Jared, his brother, and their friends ask the Lord to preserve their language. Families and provisions are gathered. They travel in the wilderness to the valley of Nimrod, receive divine guidance, cross early waters, arrive at the great sea, and begin a four-year coastal encampment.

aliases: Establishment of Jaredite Kingship and Reign of Orihah
nodes.display_name: Establishment of Jaredite Kingship and Reign of Orihah

type_details.boundary_notes: Jared founder and brother of Jared die; Orihah contextual only.
type_details.summary: The people desire a king. The brother of Jared warns that kingship leads to captivity; his sons refuse. Orihah accepts and reigns righteously. Jared and the brother of Jared die. Succession reaches Kib at Ether 7:3. Orihah remains contextual, not minted.

aliases: Ocean Crossing and Arrival in the Promised Land
nodes.display_name: Ocean Crossing and Arrival in the Promised Land

type_details.boundary_notes: 344-day voyage explicit; no B.C. year assigned.
type_details.summary: The stones are placed in the barges. The Jaredites embark; a furious wind drives them through repeated submersion and preservation for 344 days until they land, worship and give thanks, and begin to multiply in the promised land.

aliases: Kim through Lib: Captivity, Restoration, and Prosperity
nodes.display_name: Kim through Lib: Captivity, Restoration, and Prosperity

type_details.boundary_notes: Kim, Levi, Corom, Kish, Lib, Hearthom contextual; narrow neck not minted.
type_details.summary: Kim loses the kingdom and lives captive; Levi restores it after long conflict. Corom and Kish succession is compressed. Lib reigns righteously, serpents are removed from the border, southern hunting land is secured, a great city near the narrow neck flourishes, and Hearthom succeeds Lib.

aliases: King Benjamin's address at the temple
nodes.display_name: King Benjamin's address at the temple

type_details.boundary_notes: Assembly and sermon; not the entire book of Mosiah.
type_details.summary: Benjamin gathers his people and delivers his covenant sermon.

aliases: Moroni suppresses the king-men during the invasion crisis
nodes.display_name: Moroni suppresses the king-men during the invasion crisis

type_details.boundary_notes: Faction-label king-men continuity; not identical membership with later crisis.
type_details.summary: A political faction seeks to replace the free government with a king. Pahoran retains the judgment seat by the voice of the people, but the king-men refuse to defend the country during the Lamanite invasion. Moroni receives authority to suppress the rebellion and compels the survivors to support the defense.

aliases: Kishkumen's plot against Helaman and Gadianton's escape
nodes.display_name: Kishkumen's plot against Helaman and Gadianton's escape

type_details.boundary_notes: Reused ID; boundary repaired to Helaman 2:1–11. Pahoran II murder belongs to Event 1.
type_details.summary: Helaman son of Helaman is appointed chief judge. Kishkumen plots to assassinate him, but Helaman's servant infiltrates the conspiracy, Kishkumen is killed, and Gadianton's band flees into the wilderness.

type_details.boundary_notes: From Korihor's appearance through his trampling.
type_details.summary: Korihor preaches against Christ; Alma refutes him and Korihor is struck dumb.

aliases: Lamanite conquest drives the Nephites to Bountiful
nodes.display_name: Lamanite conquest drives the Nephites to Bountiful

type_details.boundary_notes: Bountiful land only—not City of Bountiful.
type_details.summary: Nephite dissensions stir Lamanite war; Zarahemla and other lands are lost and the Nephites are driven to Bountiful. Moronihah, Nephi, and Lehi preach repentance; partial recovery follows but spiritual weakness remains.

aliases: Lamanite war reaches Ammonihah and further converts join the community
nodes.display_name: Lamanite war reaches Ammonihah and further converts join the community

type_details.boundary_notes: Synchronizes narratively with Ammonihah destruction; no Event→Event chronology edge.
type_details.summary: Lamanite armies destroy Ammonihah; many Amalekites and Amulonites join the Anti-Nephi-Lehies after the slaughter.

aliases: Ammon and Lamoni encounter Lamoni's father
nodes.display_name: Ammon and Lamoni encounter Lamoni's father

type_details.boundary_notes: Route encounter; Middoni imprisonment/release is separate.
type_details.summary: While traveling toward Middoni, Ammon and Lamoni encounter Lamoni's father; the confrontation ends with Lamoni's political autonomy and promised release of the imprisoned missionaries.

aliases: Late Jaredite Kingdom Collapse and Ether's Birth
nodes.display_name: Late Jaredite Kingdom Collapse and Ether's Birth

type_details.boundary_notes: Coriantor ≠ Coriantum; no Person↔Person edge for Ether fatherhood.
type_details.summary: Shiblom-era civil conflict, rejected prophets, famine, and destruction compress through Seth, Ahah, and Ethem. Moron is overthrown; Coriantor lives in captivity and begets Ether. Ether's father is Coriantor, NOT Coriantum the prosperity king.

type_details.boundary_notes: Bounded by Lehi's call, vision, and prophetic preaching in Jerusalem; not the full book of 1 Nephi.
type_details.summary: Lehi prays and receives a vision; he prophesies to Jerusalem of its destruction.

type_details.boundary_notes: Lehi's dream bounded by the vision account through Nephi's report of it; Nephi's separate expanded vision is p1evt:nephi-expanded-vision (1 Nephi 11–14).
type_details.summary: While dwelling in a tent, Lehi dreams of the dark and dreary wilderness, the tree of life, the rod of iron, the great and spacious building, and the fate of his family in the vision.

type_details.boundary_notes: Ocean crossing only: from putting forth into the sea through the voyage before landfall at 18:23. Shipbuilding ends at 18:4; arrival begins at 18:23.
type_details.summary: After embarking, the company is driven on the sea through storms and rebellion until Nephi resumes guiding the ship.

aliases: Deliverance of Limhi's people from bondage
nodes.display_name: Deliverance of Limhi's people from bondage

type_details.boundary_notes: Escape by night through wilderness.
type_details.summary: Limhi's people escape Lamanite bondage and are led to Zarahemla.

type_details.boundary_notes: Includes Mosiah 20 priest-daughters episode through bondage before Ammon arrives.
type_details.summary: After priest-daughters conflict, Limhi's people suffer bondage and failed rescues.

aliases: Missionaries are released from prison at Middoni
nodes.display_name: Missionaries are released from prison at Middoni

type_details.boundary_notes: Actual Middoni intervention; supplementary frame at Alma 21:14–15.
type_details.summary: Lamoni and Ammon go to Middoni and obtain the release of Aaron and his brethren from prison.

aliases: Mormon obtains the plates of Nephi
nodes.display_name: Mormon obtains the plates of Nephi

type_details.boundary_notes: Distinct from Mormon 4:23 retrieval of ALL hidden records; plates-of-Nephi transfer only.
type_details.summary: Mormon reports that he followed Ammaron's instruction, took the plates of Nephi, and made a record upon them.

aliases: Mormon refuses to lead the Nephites
nodes.display_name: Mormon refuses to lead the Nephites

type_details.boundary_notes: Command withdrawal Event; editorial material after 3:16 excluded.
type_details.summary: After ten years without battle, Mormon again cries repentance. The Lamanites return in years 361 and 362 and are defeated. The Nephites boast and swear vengeance. Mormon explicitly refuses to remain their commander and becomes an idle witness according to the Lord's command.

type_details.boundary_notes: Extended editorial/prophetic discussion after 5:7 excluded.
type_details.summary: Mormon repents of his oath not to assist the Nephites and they give him command again. He leads while explicitly stating he is without hope as the Nephites continue to retreat and are destroyed.

aliases: Mormon is slain and Moroni continues the record
nodes.display_name: Mormon is slain and Moroni continues the record

type_details.boundary_notes: Mormon slain here not at Cumorah; no exact death year; Mormon 8:14+ and Mormon 9 excluded; generic robbers not auto-mapped to group:000057.
type_details.summary: Moroni takes up the task of finishing his father's record. Nephite survivors who fled south are hunted until destroyed, Mormon is also killed, and Moroni remains alone. By the 400-year marker he describes Nephites as no more and continues writing under threat.

aliases: Mormon takes command during the Nephite retreat
nodes.display_name: Mormon takes command during the Nephite retreat

type_details.boundary_notes: Reused ID; Aaron contextual; Nephite/Lamanite war context narrative.
type_details.summary: At age sixteen Mormon is appointed leader of the Nephite armies. The Lamanites force prolonged retreats. Mormon fights the Lamanite king Aaron and observes that the people's mourning is not genuine repentance.

aliases: Mormon's youth amid war and spiritual collapse
nodes.display_name: Mormon's youth amid war and spiritual collapse

type_details.boundary_notes: Do not add Jesus Christ as Person edge from visited of the Lord; Mormon's father contextual only.
type_details.summary: Mormon is carried by his father into the land of Zarahemla. War resumes between Nephites and Lamanites. Wickedness causes miracles and spiritual gifts to cease. At age fifteen Mormon is visited of the Lord, attempts to preach, and is forbidden because of the people's rebellion. Gadianton robbers among the Lamanites infest the land.

type_details.boundary_notes: Moroni's abridgment act only; no internal Jaredite narrative Events; Slice 008 scope.
type_details.summary: Moroni states that he proceeds to give an account of the ancient inhabitants, taking his account from the twenty-four plates and giving only part of the record.

aliases: Moroni rejects Ammoron's terms and frees the prisoners at Gid
nodes.display_name: Moroni rejects Ammoron's terms and frees the prisoners at Gid

type_details.boundary_notes: Alma 55 Laman remains contextual; not person:000141.
type_details.summary: Ammoron and Moroni exchange demands concerning prisoners and the war. After rejecting Ammoron's terms, Moroni uses a Lamanite-descended soldier to intoxicate the guards at Gid, arms the Nephite prisoners, surrounds the Lamanites, and retakes Gid without bloodshed.

aliases: Moroni gives his final exhortation and seals the record
nodes.display_name: Moroni gives his final exhortation and seals the record

type_details.boundary_notes: Reused ID; MORE_THAN_420_YEARS_AFTER_SIGN; no year=421; no Lamanite Group edge.
type_details.summary: Moroni states that more than 420 years have passed since the sign of Christ's coming. He says he will seal the records after his final exhortation and closes with his farewell and invitation to come unto Christ.

aliases: Moroni fortifies the Nephite lands and repels Amalickiah's first invasion
nodes.display_name: Moroni fortifies the Nephite lands and repels Amalickiah's first invasion

type_details.boundary_notes: Amalickiah does not personally assault Ammonihah; Morianton dispute excluded.
type_details.summary: Amalickiah stirs the Lamanites to war while Moroni strengthens Nephite cities and frontier defenses. The Lamanite attack fails at fortified Ammonihah and Noah, where Lehi commands the defense, and Moroni continues expanding the defensive line and founding fortified settlements.

aliases: Moroni confronts the government and learns Pahoran has been driven out
nodes.display_name: Moroni confronts the government and learns Pahoran has been driven out

type_details.boundary_notes: Gideon Land not Gideon Valley; king-men faction-label recurrence.
type_details.summary: Moroni writes an angry accusation to Pahoran and threatens action against the government unless support arrives. Pahoran replies that rebels have driven him from Zarahemla, explains that the freemen are rallying to him in Gideon, and asks Moroni to join him in restoring the government.

aliases: Moroni and Pahoran defeat the rebels and restore Zarahemla
nodes.display_name: Moroni and Pahoran defeat the rebels and restore Zarahemla

type_details.boundary_notes: Pachus contextual; Zarahemla land/city distinction preserved.
type_details.summary: Moroni marches to Gideon under the standard of liberty and joins Pahoran. Their combined forces attack the rebel regime at Zarahemla, Pachus is killed, the rebels are defeated, and Pahoran is restored to the judgment seat.

aliases: Moroni retires as peace returns and Helaman resumes his ministry
nodes.display_name: Moroni retires as peace returns and Helaman resumes his ministry

type_details.boundary_notes: Does not extend to Alma 62:52; Moronihah contextual.
type_details.summary: Moroni strengthens exposed areas and returns to Zarahemla as peace is restored. He yields command to his son Moronihah and retires. Pahoran returns to the judgment seat, and Helaman resumes preaching and helps reestablish the church throughout the land.

aliases: Moroni survives longer than expected and writes more
nodes.display_name: Moroni survives longer than expected and writes more

type_details.boundary_notes: Moroni 2–9 preserved sermons/letters/instruction excluded as standalone historical Events.
type_details.summary: After finishing the Jaredite abridgment, Moroni says he had expected not to write again but has survived. He hides from the Lamanites, refuses to deny Christ, wanders for safety, and decides to add more material.

type_details.boundary_notes: Succession and covenant ratification; distinct from Benjamin's sermon Event.
type_details.summary: Benjamin confers the kingdom on Mosiah and the people covenant under Mosiah's reign.

aliases: Moroni, Lehi, and Teancum retake Mulek
nodes.display_name: Moroni, Lehi, and Teancum retake Mulek

type_details.boundary_notes: City Mulek recovery; no Valley of Bountiful inference.
type_details.summary: Moroni joins Teancum and Lehi on the eastern front. They lure the Lamanite army from Mulek, surround it, defeat its forces, and recover the city.

type_details.boundary_notes: Nehor's teaching, killing Gideon, and execution.
type_details.summary: Nehor is tried before Alma and put to death for priestcraft and murder.

aliases: Nephi's broken bow and the food crisis
nodes.display_name: Nephi's broken bow and the food crisis

type_details.boundary_notes: Bounded by the broken bow through the end of the food-crisis episode; Ishmael's death at Nahom is a separate Event.
type_details.summary: Nephi's steel bow breaks; the company faces hunger until Nephi obtains food by faith.

aliases: Nephi builds a ship at Bountiful
nodes.display_name: Nephi builds a ship at Bountiful

type_details.boundary_notes: Command, construction, and loading; ocean crossing is a separate episode.
type_details.summary: The Lord commands Nephi to build a ship; Laman and Lemuel murmur and oppose him.

aliases: Nephi's expanded vision of the tree of life
nodes.display_name: Nephi's expanded vision of the tree of life

type_details.boundary_notes: Nephi's angel-guided vision; distinct from p1evt:lehi-tree-of-life-vision. Nephi sought understanding of Lehi's dream (1 Nephi 11:1).
type_details.summary: Nephi desires to see what his father saw. An angel guides him through visions of the birth and ministry of Christ, the apostasy, the restoration of the gospel among the Gentiles, and the destiny of Lehi's seed.

aliases: Nephi relinquishes the judgment seat and preaches with Lehi
nodes.display_name: Nephi relinquishes the judgment seat and preaches with Lehi

type_details.boundary_notes: Cezoram contextual; imprisonment begins in next Event at 5:20.
type_details.summary: Nephi relinquishes the judgment-seat to Cezoram and devotes himself to preaching with his brother Lehi among Nephites and Lamanites, remembering their father Helaman's teachings.

aliases: Nephi and Lehi are delivered from prison and Lamanites convert
nodes.display_name: Nephi and Lehi are delivered from prison and Lamanites convert

type_details.boundary_notes: Prison walls shake but are not destroyed (contrast Alma-Amulek narrative).
type_details.summary: Nephi and Lehi are imprisoned in the land of Nephi; fire encircles them, the prison walls shake, darkness and a voice call the people to repentance, and mass Lamanite conversion follows—they lay down weapons and yield lands back to the Nephites. The prison is not destroyed.

aliases: Nephi is made ruler and teacher
nodes.display_name: Nephi is made ruler and teacher

type_details.boundary_notes: Leadership consolidation after separation; closes the early Nephi arc.
type_details.summary: The people desire Nephi to be their ruler and teacher after Lehi's death.

aliases: Nephi ministers amid the tribal division
nodes.display_name: Nephi ministers amid the tribal division

type_details.boundary_notes: Timothy contextual only; not minted; no Person↔Person edge to Timothy.
type_details.summary: Nephi preaches repentance with great power during the tribal period. Angels minister to him, he casts out unclean spirits, raises his brother (later identified as Timothy) from the dead, performs miracles, and baptism expands among those who repent.

aliases: Nephi departs and entrusts the records to his son
nodes.display_name: Nephi departs and entrusts the records to his son

type_details.boundary_notes: Generational transition Event; exact departure year not encoded; not collapsed into birth-sign Event.
type_details.summary: After the ninety-first year had passed, the record notes that Nephi son of Helaman had departed and entrusted the records to his eldest son Nephi, who keeps them; Lachoneus is chief judge when the account opens.

aliases: The Lord grants Nephi sealing power
nodes.display_name: The Lord grants Nephi sealing power

type_details.boundary_notes: Full chapter narrative; not reduced to sealing verses only.
type_details.summary: After the murder-sign controversy Nephi ponders; the Lord grants sealing and loosing power including famine and destruction, commands repentance, and Nephi preaches immediately amid rejection and division.

aliases: Nephi preaches from his tower against Gadianton corruption
nodes.display_name: Nephi preaches from his tower against Gadianton corruption

type_details.boundary_notes: Garden, tower, highway, and market remain textual sublocations.
type_details.summary: Nephi returns to Zarahemla, mourns wickedness, prays from a tower in his garden, calls the people to repentance, condemns secret combinations, and invokes Moses and earlier prophets as witnesses of Christ.

aliases: The Lamanites capture Nephihah as Moroni waits for reinforcements
nodes.display_name: The Lamanites capture Nephihah as Moroni waits for reinforcements

type_details.boundary_notes: Pahoran not attached; epistle recipient only.
type_details.summary: After reading Helaman's report, Moroni asks Pahoran to reinforce the western army. While Moroni plans further recovery operations, Ammoron's forces overwhelm Nephihah, and Moroni becomes angry at what he believes is government neglect.

aliases: Moroni and Pahoran recover Nephihah and send prisoners to the people of Ammon
nodes.display_name: Moroni and Pahoran recover Nephihah and send prisoners to the people of Ammon

type_details.boundary_notes: Prisoners not labeled Amalickiahites without textual evidence.
type_details.summary: Moroni and Pahoran march toward Nephihah, capture thousands of Lamanites who covenant not to fight again, and send about four thousand of them to live with the people of Ammon. Moroni then enters Nephihah by night using cords and ladders, retakes the city without Nephite loss, and the remaining prisoners are permitted to join the people of Ammon.

aliases: Nephite collapse accelerates and Mormon recovers all records
nodes.display_name: Nephite collapse accelerates and Mormon recovers all records

type_details.boundary_notes: Mormon 4:23 = ALL records Ammaron hid; distinct from Mormon 2:17 plates of Nephi only.
type_details.summary: The Nephites launch offensive war, suffer increasingly catastrophic conflict, and after year 375 begin to be swept away. Seeing the land about to be overrun, Mormon goes to hill Shim and takes up ALL the records Ammaron had hidden.

aliases: Prosperity, pride, and collapse of Nephite government
nodes.display_name: Prosperity, pride, and collapse of Nephite government

type_details.boundary_notes: Murdered chief judge in 3 Nephi 7:1 is unnamed; not Lachoneus or Lachoneus son of Lachoneus. No Tribes Group.
type_details.summary: After restoration and prosperity, pride and class divisions intensify. Prophets are persecuted and murdered, a secret combination protects the offenders, the chief judge is murdered, central government collapses, and the people divide into independent tribes. Jacob becomes king over the secret faction and leads it away.

type_details.boundary_notes: First Lamanite re-emergence year UNKNOWN; do not assign year 84; identity was not uninterrupted through unified era.
type_details.summary: After the unified post-Christ era, a small faction revolts from the church and takes upon itself the name Lamanites. The exact year of this first re-emergence is not stated. Pride, class division, false churches, persecution, and unbelief expand. In the 231st year the text explicitly says a people arose who were called Nephites; true believers are associated with Nephite, Jacobite, Josephite, and Zoramite names, while gospel rejecters are called Lamanites, Lemuelites, and Ishmaelites.

type_details.boundary_notes: Bounded by Nephi's departure and naming of peoples.
type_details.summary: Nephi flees with supporters; Laman and Lemuel's followers become Lamanites.

aliases: Nephites and Lamanites Become One People
nodes.display_name: Nephites and Lamanites Become One People

type_details.boundary_notes: Identity transition Event; group:000086 and group:000078 remain historical IDs; 4 Nephi 1:20 Lamanite re-emergence deferred to Slice 007; no unified-people Group.
type_details.summary: After Christ's ministry, the disciples form churches throughout the lands. By the thirty-sixth year the people are all converted, both Nephites and Lamanites. Contention ceases, they have all things common, peace and prosperity continue, and the record ultimately says there are neither Lamanites nor any manner of "-ites," but the people are one. By 4 Nephi 1:17 the Nephite/Lamanite "-ite" distinctions cease as active divisions.

aliases: Noah succeeds Zeniff and establishes oppressive rule
nodes.display_name: Noah succeeds Zeniff and establishes oppressive rule

type_details.boundary_notes: Accession and oppressive rule; Abinadi's ministry begins at 11:20.
type_details.summary: Noah replaces Zeniff, builds a tower, and consecrates new priests.

type_details.boundary_notes: Reused ID; Pahoran elder is deceased context only—not an active participant.
type_details.summary: After Pahoran's death, his sons contend for the judgment-seat. Pahoran II is chosen, Paanchi rebels and is executed, Kishkumen murders Pahoran II, and Pacumeni receives the judgment-seat.

aliases: Converted community settles in Jershon and becomes known as the people of Ammon
nodes.display_name: Converted community settles in Jershon and becomes known as the people of Ammon

type_details.boundary_notes: Settlement and people-of-Ammon label; unnamed chief judge not minted.
type_details.summary: The Nephites admit the refugees, grant them Jershon, undertake their military protection, and later call the continuing community the people of Ammon.

aliases: Lehi's company arrives in the promised land
nodes.display_name: Lehi's company arrives in the promised land

type_details.boundary_notes: Arrival and settlement bounded by landing through pitching tents; not the Nephite/Lamanite division.
type_details.summary: After crossing the ocean, the company arrives and establishes themselves in the new land.

aliases: Gathering at Ramah and Destruction of the Jaredites
nodes.display_name: Gathering at Ramah and Destruction of the Jaredites

type_details.boundary_notes: Ramah = place:000144 Cumorah Hill deterministic; Coriantumr survives; no modern geography; FOUR_YEAR_GATHERING.
type_details.summary: Coriantumr camps at hill Ramah, explicitly the same hill where Mormon later hid sacred records. A four-year gathering brings every remaining people into two armed sides. Final multi-day slaughter leaves only Coriantumr and Shiz for the duel. Coriantumr decapitates Shiz; Shiz dies; Coriantumr falls as though lifeless but SURVIVES. Ether sees prophecy fulfilled and finishes/hides the record. Nearly two million mighty men with wives and children additional — not converted to total population.

aliases: Mosiah establishes the reign of the judges
nodes.display_name: Mosiah establishes the reign of the judges

type_details.boundary_notes: Ends at 29:44; does not extend into 29:45–47.
type_details.summary: With his sons unwilling to receive the kingdom, Mosiah proposes government by judges; the people accept the system, Alma becomes first chief judge, and the reign of the judges begins.

aliases: Royal protection enables widespread Lamanite conversion
nodes.display_name: Royal protection enables widespread Lamanite conversion

type_details.boundary_notes: Conversion census under royal protection; naming at 23:16 is separate Event.
type_details.summary: After royal conversion, many Lamanites in multiple lands and cities are converted through the preaching of the sons of Mosiah.

aliases: Samuel the Lamanite preaches on the wall
nodes.display_name: Samuel the Lamanite preaches on the wall

type_details.boundary_notes: Reused ID; one Samuel narrative—not split into micro-events.
type_details.summary: Samuel the Lamanite preaches to the Nephites, climbs the wall of Zarahemla, prophesies signs of Christ's birth and death, believers seek Nephi who baptizes them, attackers fail to harm Samuel, and he escapes to his own country.

aliases: Nephi foretells and reveals Seezoram's murder
nodes.display_name: Nephi foretells and reveals Seezoram's murder

type_details.boundary_notes: Seezoram and Seantum contextual; not minted; no Cezoram genealogy.
type_details.summary: Nephi declares the chief judge Seezoram has been murdered by his brother Seantum; messengers verify the death, Seantum is tested and confesses, and Nephi is vindicated amid debate over whether he is a prophet or a god.

aliases: Nephites defend at Shem and make a territorial treaty
nodes.display_name: Nephites defend at Shem and make a territorial treaty

type_details.boundary_notes: Lamanites and robbers named separately at 2:28; robbers not a sovereign state; no Shem Place edge.
type_details.summary: The Nephites retreat to Shem, fortify, rally, and withstand superior forces. They later regain lands and in the 350th year make a treaty with the Lamanites and Gadianton robbers dividing territorial control between the northward and southward lands.

type_details.boundary_notes: Shez, Riplakish, Morianton contextual only.
type_details.summary: Shez rebuilds the kingdom. Riplakish reigns with taxation, forced labor, and prisons until popular overthrow. Morianton gathers outcasts, reconquers, and administers civil order despite personal wickedness.

aliases: Shiz's War of Destruction against Coriantumr
nodes.display_name: Shiz's War of Destruction against Coriantumr

type_details.boundary_notes: Shiz = brother of Lib; battle geography contextual where unresolved.
type_details.summary: Shiz succeeds his brother Lib and wages vengeance, destroying cities and killing men, women, and children until the people polarize around Shiz or Coriantumr. Coriantumr offers peace; Shiz demands Coriantumr's life. Warfare moves toward Ogath and the Ramah setup through Ether 15:10. Ramah Event does NOT begin at Ether 15:1.

aliases: Sons of Mosiah obtain authorization for the Lamanite mission
nodes.display_name: Sons of Mosiah obtain authorization for the Lamanite mission

type_details.boundary_notes: Authorization and departure; not Alma 17 separation.
type_details.summary: The sons of Mosiah ask to preach among the Lamanites; Mosiah seeks divine direction, grants permission, and the missionaries depart.

aliases: Missionaries separate at the Lamanite borders
nodes.display_name: Missionaries separate at the Lamanite borders

type_details.boundary_notes: Separation only; Aaron callback at Alma 21:1.
type_details.summary: Ammon and Aaron separate from their companions at the borders of the Lamanite lands.

aliases: The sons of the people of Ammon form Helaman's army
nodes.display_name: The sons of the people of Ammon form Helaman's army

type_details.boundary_notes: Parent community group:000014; warrior unit distinct.
type_details.summary: The people of Ammon consider breaking their covenant in order to defend the Nephites, but Helaman persuades them not to break it. Their sons, who had not entered that covenant, take up arms, covenant to defend the Nephites, and two thousand march under Helaman.

aliases: Teancum kills Amalickiah and Ammoron succeeds him
nodes.display_name: Teancum kills Amalickiah and Ammoron succeeds him

type_details.boundary_notes: Reused ID; seashore by Land Bountiful; no City Bountiful.
type_details.summary: Teancum enters Amalickiah's camp at night and kills him with a javelin. The Lamanite army abandons its immediate northward advance, and Amalickiah's brother Ammoron is appointed king and orders the captured cities held.

aliases: Teancum kills Ammoron and the Lamanite armies are driven out
nodes.display_name: Teancum kills Ammoron and the Lamanite armies are driven out

type_details.boundary_notes: Land Lehi/Moroni only; Helaman striplings not attached.
type_details.summary: Moroni pursues the retreating Lamanites from Nephihah toward Lehi and Moroni, where Lehi and Teancum help encircle the remaining Lamanite armies. Teancum enters the enemy camp and kills Ammoron but is himself killed. Moroni attacks the next day and drives the remaining Lamanites from the land, bringing the long war to an end.

aliases: Three disciples are changed and begin their ministry
nodes.display_name: Three disciples are changed and begin their ministry

type_details.boundary_notes: Three disciples unnamed; no Person edges; Three Nephites is contextual alias only; 3 Nephi 28:24–40 is editorial material outside this Event.
type_details.summary: After Christ departs, the heavens open to the three disciples who had desired to remain. They are caught up, experience things they cannot utter, return to earth, and continue their ministry through persecution and miraculous deliverances.

aliases: Lehi's company camps in the Valley of Lemuel
nodes.display_name: Lehi's company camps in the Valley of Lemuel

type_details.boundary_notes: Bounded by arrival at the valley through Lehi's exhortation to Laman and Lemuel; not the full wilderness arc.
type_details.summary: After departing Jerusalem, Lehi's family travels and camps in a valley by a river.

aliases: Lehi's company travels by the Liahona
nodes.display_name: Lehi's company travels by the Liahona

type_details.boundary_notes: Travel guided by the Liahona before the broken-bow crisis; not every verse of chapter 16.
type_details.summary: The company journeys in the wilderness guided by the Liahona after Ishmael's family joins.

aliases: Zeezrom is healed and the church is established at Sidom
nodes.display_name: Zeezrom is healed and the church is established at Sidom

type_details.boundary_notes: Land of Sidom; no inferred Sidom city.
type_details.summary: Alma and Amulek join the expelled believers in Sidom. Alma heals and baptizes Zeezrom, Zeezrom begins preaching, a church is established and many are baptized, and Alma later returns to Zarahemla with Amulek.

aliases: Zeniff leads expedition from Zarahemla toward Nephi
nodes.display_name: Zeniff leads expedition from Zarahemla toward Nephi

type_details.boundary_notes: Expedition only; does not include Zeniff's treaty, reign, or wars.
type_details.summary: Zeniff returns toward the land of Nephi with a company from Zarahemla.

aliases: Zeniff's reign and defense against Lamanites
nodes.display_name: Zeniff's reign and defense against Lamanites

type_details.boundary_notes: Reign and Lamanite wars; ends before Noah's accession at 11:1.
type_details.summary: Zeniff possesses Lehi-Nephi and Shilom and fights to defend his people.

aliases: Moroni and Lehi defeat Zerahemnah's army
nodes.display_name: Moroni and Lehi defeat Zerahemnah's army

type_details.boundary_notes: Zerahemnah war; generic Nephite/Lamanite sides permitted.
type_details.summary: The Lamanite army under Zerahemnah invades. Moroni prepares the Nephites, consults Alma concerning the enemy route, and coordinates with Lehi to surround Zerahemnah's army near Sidon. After renewed fighting, the Lamanites enter a covenant of peace and depart.

aliases: Alma and companions minister to the Zoramites at Antionum
nodes.display_name: Alma and companions minister to the Zoramites at Antionum

type_details.boundary_notes: Zoramite mission bounded Alma 31–34; Alma 35 war with Zoramites is outside this Event.
type_details.summary: Alma learns the Zoramites have apostatized and gathers companions to preach in Antionum. They observe Rameumptom worship, Alma and Amulek preach repentance, and Alma teaches faith and the plan of redemption to the poor among the Zoramites.

type_details.internal_notes: No confident forge Person crosswalk located. Census omission-control row 85: Paanchi (Wars & Late Judges).

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now these are their names who did contend for the judgment-seat, who did also cause the people to contend: Pahoran, Paanchi, and Pacumeni.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Must be disambiguated from his son, Pahoran II, who briefly succeeds him in Helaman 1 before being assassinated. Classification disagreement: Gemini=IDENTITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED, Perplexity=PHASE1_SUPPORTING.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now behold, his name was Pahoran. And Pahoran did fill the seat of his father, and did commence his reign in the end of the twenty and fourth year, over the people of Nephi.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Pahoran refuses to alter the law to establish a king, triggering the king-men rebellion.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that those who were desirous that Pahoran should be dethroned from the judgment-seat were called king-men, for they were desirous that the law should be altered in a manner to overthrow the free government and to establish a king over the land.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Pahoran reveals his lack of anger toward Moroni's unjust accusations.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And now, in your epistle you have censured me, but it mattereth not; I am not angry, but do rejoice in the greatness of your heart. I, Pahoran, do not seek for power, save only to retain my judgment-seat that I may preserve the rights and the liberty of my people. My soul standeth fast in that liberty in the which God hath made us free.

type_details.internal_notes: No confident forge Person crosswalk located. Census omission-control row 84: Pahoran II (Wars & Late Judges).

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: For behold, Pahoran had died, and gone the way of all the earth; therefore there began to be a serious contention concerning who should have the judgment-seat among the brethren, who were the sons of Pahoran.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Sam's identity is unique and highly stable throughout the text.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And he came down by the borders near the shore of the Red Sea; and he traveled in the wilderness in the borders which are nearer the Red Sea; and he did travel in the wilderness with his family, which consisted of my mother, Sariah, and my elder brothers, who were Laman, Lemuel, and Sam.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Sam believes Nephi's prophetic words and is immediately converted.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And I spake unto Sam, making known unto him the things which the Lord had manifested unto me by his Holy Spirit. And it came to pass that he believed in my words.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Lehi blesses Sam, covenanting that his seed will be permanently joined with Nephi's seed.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And after he had made an end of speaking unto them, he spake unto Sam, saying: Blessed art thou, and thy seed; for thou shall inherit the land like unto thy brother Nephi. And thy seed shall be numbered with his seed; and thou shalt be even like unto thy brother, and thy seed like unto his seed; and thou shalt be blessed in all thy days.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Samuel the Lamanite requires careful cross-domain disambiguation from the biblical Samuel, though in the internal Nephite record, he is the only Samuel.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that in this year there was one Samuel, a Lamanite, came into the land of Zarahemla, and began to preach unto the people. And it came to pass that he did preach, many days, repentance unto the people, and they did cast him out, and he was about to return to his own land.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Samuel prophesies the specific five-year sign of Christ's birth.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And behold, he said unto them: Behold, I give unto you a sign; for five years more cometh, and behold, then cometh the Son of God to redeem all those who shall believe on his name.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Nephites attempt to shoot Samuel on the wall with arrows and stones, but he is miraculously preserved.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: But as many as there were who did not believe in the words of Samuel were angry with him; and they cast stones at him upon the wall, and also many shot arrows at him as he stood upon the wall; but the Spirit of the Lord was with him, insomuch that they could not hit him with their stones neither with their arrows.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Sariah is a unique name in the record; her identity as the founding matriarch is stable and requires no disambiguation.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And he came down by the borders near the shore of the Red Sea; and he traveled in the wilderness in the borders which are nearer the Red Sea; and he did travel in the wilderness with his family, which consisted of my mother, Sariah, and my elder brothers, who were Laman, Lemuel, and Sam.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Sariah murmurs against Lehi in grief, fearing the death of her sons.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: For she had supposed that we had perished in the wilderness; and she also had complained against my father, telling him that he was a visionary man; saying: Behold thou hast led us forth from the land of our inheritance, and my sons are no more, and we perish in the wilderness.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Sariah receives a witness and formally testifies of divine protection.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And she spake, saying: Now I know of a surety that the Lord hath commanded my husband to flee into the wilderness; yea, and I also know of a surety that the Lord hath protected my sons, and delivered them out of the hands of Laban, and given them power whereby they could accomplish the thing which the Lord hath commanded them. And after this manner of language did she speak.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Sherem is a unique name in the Book of Mormon; his identity is stable and requires no disambiguation.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And now it came to pass after some years had passed away, there came a man among the people of Nephi, whose name was Sherem.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Sherem preaches flattering words, actively denying the future coming of Christ.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that he began to preach among the people, and to declare unto them that there should be no Christ. And he preached many things which were flattering unto the people; and this he did that he might overthrow the doctrine of Christ.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Sherem is struck down by God after demanding a physical sign from Jacob.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that when I, Jacob, had spoken these words, the power of the Lord came upon him, insomuch that he fell to the earth. And it came to pass that he was nourished for the space of many days.

Now the eldest of his sons he took not with him, and his name was Helaman; but the names of those whom he took with him were Shiblon and Corianton; and these are the names of those who went with him among the Zoramites, to preach unto them the word.

type_details.internal_notes: No confident forge Person crosswalk located. Gemini: Shiz is a unique name in the Book of Mormon, highly stable and requiring no disambiguation.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now the name of the brother of Lib was called Shiz. And it came to pass that Shiz pursued after Coriantumr, and he did overthrow many cities, and he did slay both women and children, and he did burn the cities.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Coriantumr decapitates Shiz, who struggles for breath and dies, ending the Jaredite nation.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that when Coriantumr had leaned upon his sword, that he rested a little, he smote off the head of Shiz.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Coriantumr decapitates Shiz, who struggles for breath and dies, ending the Jaredite nation.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that after he had smitten off the head of Shiz, that Shiz raised upon his hands and fell; and after that he had struggled for breath, he died.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Teancum is a unique name of a person, though his name is later used for a city (City of Teancum). Disambiguation from the city is needed.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that the army which was sent by Moroni, which was led by a man whose name was Teancum, did meet the people of Morianton; and so stubborn were the people of Morianton, (being inspired by his wickedness and his flattering words) that a battle commenced between them, in the which Teancum did slay Morianton and defeat his army, and took them prisoners, and returned to the camp of Moroni. And thus ended the twenty and fourth year of the reign of the judges over the people of Nephi.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Teancum slays Amalickiah's army on the beach, stopping their seemingly invincible march.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: But behold he met with a disappointment by being repulsed by Teancum and his men, for they were great warriors; for every man of Teancum did exceed the Lamanites in their strength and in their skill of war, insomuch that they did gain advantage over the Lamanites.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Teancum's death at the hands of Ammoron's guards, lamented heavily by the nation.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now it came to pass that when Lehi and Moroni knew that Teancum was dead they were exceedingly sorrowful; for behold, he had been a man who had fought valiantly for his country, yea, a true friend to liberty; and he had suffered very many exceedingly sore afflictions. But behold, he was dead, and had gone the way of all the earth.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And they discovered a people, who were called the people of Zarahemla. Now, there was great rejoicing among the people of Zarahemla; and also Zarahemla did rejoice exceedingly, because the Lord had sent the people of Mosiah with the plates of brass which contained the record of the Jews.
And there was one among them whose name was Zeezrom. Now he was the foremost to accuse Amulek and Alma, he being one of the most expert among them, having much business to do among the people.

type_details.internal_notes: Census omission-control row 100: Zemnarihah (Ministry & Decline).

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: Now they had appointed unto themselves another leader, whose name was Zemnarihah; therefore it was Zemnarihah that did cause that this siege should take place.

type_details.internal_notes: Gemini: Zeniff's identity is unique and highly stable.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: I, Zeniff, having been taught in all the language of the Nephites, and having had a knowledge of the land of Nephi, or of the land of our fathers’ first inheritance, and having been sent as a spy among the Lamanites that I might spy out their forces, that our army might come upon them and destroy them—but when I saw that which was good among them I was desirous that they should not be destroyed.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Zeniff leads his people to victory against Lamanite invasions, establishing temporary defense.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: For this very cause has king Laman, by his cunning, and lying craftiness, and his fair promises, deceived me, that I have brought this my people up into this land, that they may destroy them; yea, and we have suffered these many years in the land.

And they were inspired by the Zoramites and the Amalekites, who were their chief captains and leaders, and by Zerahemnah, who was their chief captain, or their chief leader and commander; yea, they did fight like dragons, and many of the Nephites were slain by their hands, yea, for they did smite in two many of their head-plates, and they did pierce many of their breastplates, and they did smite off many of their arms; and thus the Lamanites did smite in their fierce anger.

type_details.internal_notes: No confident forge Person crosswalk located. Gemini: Zoram requires careful identity review because of later figures called Zoram (e.g., Zoram the chief captain in Alma 16, or Zoram the apostate leader in Alma 31). Disambiguation from his descendants is necessary.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And it came to pass that Zoram did take courage at the words which I spake. Now Zoram was the name of the servant; and he promised that he would go down into the wilderness unto our father. Yea, and he also made an oath unto us that he would tarry with us from that time forth.

primary_scripture_identity_evidence.claim: Lehi formally blesses Zoram, designating him as a true friend and permanently grafting his lineage into Nephi's.
primary_scripture_identity_evidence.verse_text: And now Zoram, I speak unto you: Behold, thou art the servant of Laban; nevertheless, thou hast been brought out of the land of Jerusalem, and I know that thou art a true friend unto my son, Nephi, forever.
